name: AI Deep Dive — TSEM — 2026-05-02
rationale: Tower Semiconductor (TSEM) has surged nearly 500% over the past year, commanding a premium $25.9B valuation on $1.56B of revenue. While operational health is strong (Piotroski F-Score 7, 14% net margins), the 45x forward P/E prices in an aggressive, flawless growth trajectory that contrasts with their historically cyclical foundry business. Weighted PV of $114.73 points to severe overvaluation and suggests taking profits.

aiThesis.rationale: TSEM's 500% 1-year surge is largely driven by a broader semiconductor re-rating rather than underlying fundamentals justifying a $26B market cap. While the company is well-run (F-Score of 7, solid 14% margins), its core business is specialty analog foundries, not cutting-edge AI chips. At nearly 17x trailing sales and 45x forward earnings, the market is pricing TSEM like a hyper-growth tech firm rather than a capital-intensive manufacturer. The base case ($114 PV) assumes a robust 15% CAGR and 16% margins, but this still implies nearly 50% downside from the current price. It's a high-quality company trapped in an irrational valuation bubble.
